idea: Build an exhaustive axis-aligned "count-sum" table T[p][q] over integer rectangles p×q (p,q ≤ 2√n+4), where each entry is a Pareto set of (count, sum) pairs. Fill it with exact-Fraction guillotine recursion that also allows the cell itself to be one square plus a remainder strip. Then return, for the unit square, the best entry at exactly n over all board sizes L, reconstructing the layout from stored back-pointers.
